--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8980'
+title: 'bench: install the `packages` word list of a spec, so 105 instances get their test tools'
+---
+## What this is
+
+`bench/swebench_venv.py` installs the `pip_packages` of a spec, and the
+requirements file when `packages` names one. That is what the card
+[[bench-prepare-the-instance-environment-in-the-driver]] asks for, word for
+word, and it is what that work does.
+
+But `packages` takes a third form, and this work does not read it. The value
+is then a list of conda package names, separated by spaces:
+
+| Repository | The value of `packages` | Instances of Lite |
+|---|---|---|
+| sympy/sympy | `mpmath flake8` | 76 |
+| scikit-learn/scikit-learn | `numpy scipy cython pytest pandas matplotlib` | 19 |
+| psf/requests | `pytest` | 6 |
+| scikit-learn/scikit-learn | `'numpy==1.19.2' 'scipy==1.5.2' 'cython==3.0.10' ...` | 4 |
+| astropy/astropy | `setuptools==38.2.4` | 2 |
+
+## Why it is a problem
+
+None of those 105 instances gets `pytest` from its `pip_packages`, and each of
+them has `pytest -rA` as its `test_cmd` (sympy uses `bin/test`). Measured on
+this machine on 2026-09-12, with a real build of `psf__requests-2317`:
+
+```
+status built python 3.9 seconds 2.4
+import requests -> ok
+python -m pytest --version -> No module named pytest
+```
+
+The environment imports the package, and the agent still cannot run one test
+of the instance. The agent then installs pytest itself, which is the work
+that the environment step exists to remove.
+
+## The work
+
+- Install a `packages` value that is neither `requirements.txt` nor
+  `environment.yml` with the pip of the environment of the instance.
+- Read the value with `shlex.split`, because one value of scikit-learn holds
+  quoted names: `'numpy==1.19.2' 'scipy==1.5.2'`.
+- Leave `environment.yml` as it is. It is a conda file, and pip cannot read
+  one. 27 instances name it.
+- Add a test for each of the three forms, beside the tests that are there.
+- Build one real `psf__requests` instance by hand, and prove that
+  `python -m pytest --version` answers in its environment.
+
+## What to watch
+
+A conda name is not always a PyPI name. Each of the names in the table above
+is on PyPI, so this should hold for the Lite split, but a build that fails
+here must give the record row the reason, exactly as the other build failures
+do.
+
+#bench
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed, with the measurement the card asks for.
+
+    The change:
+    - `bench/swebench_venv.py`: a `CONDA_PACKAGES` constant for `environment.yml`, a new `packages_word_list(spec)` that reads the value with `shlex.split` and gives an empty list for `requirements.txt`, for `environment.yml` and for a spec with no `packages`, and one more pip command in `build_commands`, after the `pip_packages` and before the requirements file. The module docstring holds a new section, THE THREE FORMS OF `packages`, with the table of the three values and their counts.
+    - `bench/test_swebench_venv.py`: a class `ThePackagesThatPipInstalls` with one test for each form, two tests in `TheCommandsOfTheBuild`, and a class `TheWordListInABuild` for the run.
+    - `bench/test_fixtures.py`: `a_runner` takes `answers_when`, a function of the command, beside `answers_at`, and `a_refusing_runner(word)` uses it. A test of the failure of the word list then names the COMMAND and not its number, so one command more in the row cannot move the test to another command.
+    - `bench/README.md`: the bullet of the word list, the measurement, and what a name that pip refuses does.
+
+    The red proof: with `packages_word_list` made to answer `[]` (the code before the change), 7 tests fail and 2 error, and each one is a test of the word list. With the change, 192 tests of `bench/` pass, and `ruff --isolated --select D1,PLR0915,PLR2004` is clean on the three files.
+
+    The real build, on this machine on 2026-09-12: `psf__requests-2317`, spec `{'python': '3.9', 'packages': 'pytest', 'install': 'python -m pip install .', 'test_cmd': 'pytest -rA'}`.
+
+    ```
+    status built python 3.9 seconds 3.9
+    import requests -> ok
+    python -m pytest --version -> pytest 8.4.2
+    ```
+
+    The card measured `No module named pytest` for the same instance before this change.
+
+    A name that pip cannot install: the card asks for the reason in the record row, and the machinery of the module already gives it. The pip command of the word list fails like every other build command, so the row holds `env_status` `failed`, the exit code, a reason with the whole command (and thus each name) in it, and the last 40 lines of what pip wrote. The build stops there, and the agent does not start with an environment that has no test runner. Three tests hold that behaviour. One list, and not one command for each name: the card asks to install the value, and a row of commands for each name would hide which name is bad behind a longer log.
